blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在诚实至关重要的情景中正变得普遍. 然而,尽管进行了校正培训,这些模式仍然表现出不诚实的行为,例如提出与某些知识相矛盾或得不到背景可获取内容支持的诉求。 我们引进了 " 一致诚实的持续横向培训 " (CATCH),其灵感来自最初为强烈拒绝有害询问而开发的方法。 CATCH将模型训练为诚实的答案,并远离不诚实的答案,同时保持模型的能力. 我们评价两个建筑(Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和Qune3-3.6-27B). 我们显示,经过培训的只有数百个从自我报告设想中制定的目标,CATCH学习了一种诚实的行为,有力地概括了不同基准之间的转移。 它在MASCK的压力下持续地减少不诚实,在"我们之间"的多代理游戏中增加口供,并提升了该模型在"审计本奇"中隐藏行为的发现率. 我们显示,CATCH在提高诚实性方面表现优于激励和监督的微调,它与最先进的诚实性激活方向相同。 然而,由于对公用数据作出了新的选择,CATCH在维持公用方面超越了诚实指导。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integrated into many people’s daily lives and workflows; in both, harmlessness and honesty matter. Alignment training is meant to provide this, and much work has gone into it. Aligned models, nonetheless, still exhibit dishonest behaviours. These behaviours manifest in different ways. For instance, models hack or take shortcuts to get a higher reward without fulfilling the task’s intention ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) . Notably, in a recent incident at OpenAI, agents worked together to cheat in an evaluation by breaching a third party’s infrastructure to retrieve the solutions, covering their traces to hide their cheating attempts ( Greenblatt et al., 2026 ) . On the other hand, models can directly lie to the user, for example, faking alignment ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) ; claiming task completion that they didn’t achieve ( Greenblatt, 2026 ; Smyth et al., 2026 ) ; telling users what they think the user wants to hear, even when it is not factually correct ( Fanous et al., 2025 ) ; or simply making claims that contradicts some knowledge, whether it is a fact learnt during training or provided in context. In this paper, we particularly focus on this latter, which Ren et al. (2025) show does not go away even when the models get larger/more capable.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模式正日益融入许多人的日常生活和工作流程;无论在无害还是诚实方面,都是重要的。 调整培训是为了提供这种培训,为此做了许多工作。 然而,结盟模式仍然显示出不诚实的行为。 这些行为表现在不同的方面。 例如,模型黑客或走捷径以获得更高的奖励而不满足任务意图(Skalse等人,2022年)。 值得注意的是,在OpenAI最近发生的一起事件中,特工们通过破坏第三方的基础设施以获取解决方案来进行欺骗,掩盖他们的欺诈企图(Greenblatt等,2026年)。 另一方面,模型可以直接骗用户,例如:假配对(Greenblatt等,2024年;声称任务完成他们没有实现(Greenblatt等,2026年;Smyth等,2026年;)),告诉用户他们认为用户想要听到什么,即使这不符合事实(Fanous等,2025年),或者简单地提出与某些知识相矛盾的主张,无论是在训练中吸取的事实还是根据背景提供. 在本文中,我们特别关注后者,Ren等人(2025年)表示,即使模型变大/能力更强,后者也不会消失.

blocks.en: Different techniques exist to control a model’s propensity to lie. Activation steering alters the model’s behaviour at inference time by intervening on its activations ( Zou et al., 2025 ; Turner et al., 2024 ; Herbster et al., 2026 ) . Nonetheless, benign steering can lead to increased vulnerability to jailbreaks ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) , decreased capability, and unintended changes in a model’s behaviour that’s not the targeted trait ( Siu et al., 2026 ) . Others consider honest prompting ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , emphasizing honesty in the system prompt or assigning models an honest persona; however, a single prompt that induces honesty across different conditions may be hard or impossible to design. Another popular approach is supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on harmful system prompts along with honest responses; yet, this requires large corpora of synthetic data ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and may not generalize out of distribution.
blocks.zh: 控制模型说谎倾向的方法不同。 活性引导通过干预模型的活性化时间改变模型的行为(Zou等人,2025年;Turner等人,2024年;Herbster等人,2026年)。 尽管如此,良性引导可能导致更容易被越狱(Xiong等,2026年),能力下降,以及模式行为非目标特征的意外变化(Siu等,2026年)。 其他人则认为诚实激励(Wang等,2025年),强调体系中的诚实激励或指派一个诚实的人物a;然而,单一的激励不同条件的诚实激励可能是很难或不可能设计的. 另一种受人欢迎的方法是对有害的系统提示进行监督微调(SFT),同时作出诚实的响应;然而,这需要大量合成数据(Wang等人,2025年),并且可能不会被普遍化而不再分发。

blocks.en: An open problem in the field is to be able to find a single intervention that works across different manifestations of dishonesty. This could be seen as a robustness problem, where a method is defined as robust when it mitigates dishonesty independently of how it arises. One potential approach to address this is Continous Adversarial Training (CAT) ( Xhonneux et al., 2024 ) , initially proposed to make a model’s refusal behaviour robust against a variety of jailbreaks. Here we modified CAT to make a model’s honest behaviour robust to three different forms of dishonesty: 1) instructed dishonesty, where a system prompt contains explicit pressure to lie; 2) dishonesty that emerges from incentives in a multi-agent game, where being dishonest increases expected reward; and 3) dishonesty that results from having trained a model to conceal the truth. We name this approach Continous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty ( CATCH ) and summarize it in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 该领域的一个公开问题是能够找到一种单一的干预,在各种不诚实的表现中发挥作用。 这可被视为一个强力问题,即一种方法在减轻不诚实时被定义为强力,而不管它是如何产生的。 解决此问题的一个潜在办法是相矛盾的横向培训(Xhonneux等,2024年),最初提出要让一个模型的拒绝行为对各种越狱行为有力. 在这里,我们修改了CAT,使模型的诚实行为强大到三种不同形式的不诚实: 1) 指使不诚实行为,即一个系统即刻含有明确的撒谎压力;2) 由多代理游戏中的动机产生的不诚实行为,即不诚实行为会增加预期的回报;3) 培训一个模型来掩盖真相所产生的不诚实行为。 我们把这一方针命名为 " 一贯诚实的对抗性横向培训 " (CATCH),并在图1中加以总结。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce CATCH , a method that makes a model learn to exhibit honest behaviours across conditions, while highly preserving capabilities. • The learnt honest behaviour is robust and consistent: it reduces instructed dishonesty in MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , counteracts dishonesty resulting from game incentives in Among Us ( Golechha and Garriga-Alonso, 2025 ) , and unveils dishonesty learned through training in AuditBench ( Sheshadri et al., 2026 ) . • Despite using only around 200 instances of training data taken from Herbster et al. (2026) , our method outperforms all baseline methods and is on par with their SOTA honesty steering on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3.6-27B, particularly surpassing an implementation of honesty-SFT trained on roughly 50 times as much honesty data ( Wang et al., 2025 ) on MASK. • We study the effect of the utility dataset used during training, and find a novel approach to choosing a utility dataset that allows higher general capability preservation, outperforming the SOTA honesty steering.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work on trustworthy LLMs spans several related but distinct goals, including factual accuracy, hallucination reduction, calibration, uncertainty expression, and cross-prompt consistency ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Chern et al., 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . These settings measure reliability, but they do not directly test whether a model knowingly produces statements that conflict with its knowledge under pressure. As a result, improvements on the benchmarks may reflect broader knowledge or better calibration rather than honesty ( Ren et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 以往关于可信赖的LLMS的工作涉及若干相关但不同的目标,包括事实准确性、减少幻觉、校准、不确定性表达和交叉瞬间的一致性(Lin等,2022;Li等,2023;Chern等,2024;Xiong等,2024)。 这些设置衡量可靠性,但并不直接测试模型是否在压力下故意生成与其知识相冲突的声明. 因此,基准的改进可能反映更广泛的知识或更好的校准,而不是诚实(Ren等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) formalizes the distinction, comparing a model’s pressured output against its independently elicited belief, and finds that the tendency to lie under pressure does not decrease with scale even as factual accuracy improves. Smyth et al. (2026) find similar dishonest behaviour in frontier coding agents, which failed to read all files they were requested to review 67.9% of runs, and implied complete coverage in 80.4% of those cases.
blocks.zh: MASK(Ren等,2025年)将区别正式化,将模型的压力输出与其独立引出的信条进行比较,并发现即使随着事实准确度的提高,压力下的倾向也不会随规模而降低. Smyth等人(2026年)发现边境编码人员有类似的不诚实行为,他们没有阅读所有要求他们审查67.9%的运行情况的文件,这意味着80.4%的运行情况完全覆盖。

blocks.en: For inference-time interventions, one could simply insert an honesty instruction to the prompt; but it relies on the model to police itself, and the improvement does not generalize ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . Activation steering ( Turner et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) intervenes on the residual stream, and two recent methods target honesty directly. Góral et al. (2025) distribute a fixed steering budget across depth with a Gaussian schedule, while Herbster et al. (2026) uses a logistic-regression decision boundary to determine which tokens to steer and projection geometry to determine by how much.
blocks.zh: 就推断时间干预而言,人们可以简单地在提示中插入诚实指示;但它依靠模式来维持治安,而改进并不普遍(Ren等人,2025年)。 活性向导(Turner等,2024;Zou等,2025)干预了残流,而最近两种方法直接以诚实为目标. 高尔等. (2025年)用高斯表在深度分配固定的引导预算,而赫伯斯特等(2026年)则使用物流后退决定边界来决定指向和投影几何的标志,以决定多少.

blocks.en: For training-time interventions, Wang et al. (2025) find SFT on harmful system prompts along with honest responses to be the strongest mitigation. Beyond SFT, Jagadeesh et al. (2026) train truthfulness as one of several beneficial traits with RL and report that the behaviour persists under adversarial prompting and harmful fine-tuning, and Joglekar et al. (2025) train a separately-rewarded confession issued after each answer.
blocks.zh: 就培训时间干预而言,Wang等人(2025年)认为,SFT关于有害系统的反应与诚实的反应一道,是最有力的缓解措施。 除了SFT之外,Jagadeesh等人(2026年)将诚实作为RL的几个有益特征之一进行训练,并报告说,这种行为在对抗诱导和有害的微调下持续存在,而Joglekar等人(2025年)则在每次回答后进行单独奖励的供述。

blocks.en:
A parallel line of work studies aligned LLMs through the lens of adversarial robustness. Automatically optimized suffix attacks such as GCG ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , together with jailbreak methods such as PAIR ( Chao et al., 2025 ) and AutoDAN ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , show that safety-aligned models remain vulnerable to targeted prompt perturbations that induce harmful behaviour. To defend against these attacks, Mazeika et al. (2024) demonstrates that adversarial training can improve robust refusal; however, discrete attack generation is computationally expensive. CAT addresses this bottleneck by replacing discrete token search with embedding-space perturbations, showing that robustness to continuous attacks transfers to discrete jailbreaks while being substantially more efficient to train ( Xhonneux et al., 2024 ) . Similarly, Latent adversarial training perturbs hidden activations instead of input embeddings and improves robustness to harmful behaviours ( Casper et al., 2025 ) .
These methods have been evaluated primarily on suppression of harmful outputs and robustness towards jailbreaks, rather than on honesty. Our work targets this gap by adapting CAT from safety alignment to honesty alignment.
blocks.zh:
平行的工作领域研究通过对抗力强的视角调整了法学硕士学位。 GCG(邹等,2023年)等自动优化后缀攻击,加之PAIR(Chao等,2025年)和AutoDAN(Liu等,2024年)等越狱方法,显示安全结合模式仍然容易受到有针对性地即时扰动而诱发有害行为. 为了抵御这些袭击,Mazeika等人(2024年)表明,对抗性训练可以改善强烈的拒绝;但是,离散的攻击生成在计算上是昂贵的。 禁止酷刑委员会解决了这一瓶颈问题,用嵌入式空间扰动取代了离散符号搜索,表明持续攻击向离散的越狱转移的强大性,同时大大提高了培训的效率(Xhonneux等,2024年)。 同样,Latent对抗性训练隐蔽地激活而不是嵌入输入,并提高了有害行为的稳健性(Casper等人,2025年)。
对这些方法的评估主要针对抑制有害的产物和对越狱的强烈性,而不是诚实。 我们的工作通过使CAT从安全调整到诚实调整来弥补这一差距。

blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Let x x be a prompt containing some pressure to lie and a proposition the model is being pushed to misstate. Following ( Xhonneux et al., 2024 ) , we associate with x x two continuations: y + y^{+} , an answer consistent with with the knowledge available to the model, whether learnt during training or supplied in context; and y − y^{-} , an answer that complies with the pressure and asserts the contrary. A model is dishonest on x x when it has a high probability to output y − y^{-} .

blocks.en: Training models for honesty is different from safeguarding models against generating harmful outputs in jailbreaking. In safety alignment, a single generic refusal “ Sorry, I can’t do that ” serves as the toward-target y + y^{+} for every harmful prompt ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ; Xhonneux et al., 2024 ) , and the away-target y − y^{-} typically begins with a compliance prefix such as “ Sure ”. However, for honesty, both the truth and lie depend on the context, so both targets must be constructed case-by-case.
blocks.zh: 诚实培训模式不同于保护模式,防止在越狱中产生有害结果。 在安全调整方面,一个一般性的拒绝“抱歉,我不能这样做”是针对每一个有害的提示(Mazeika等人,2024年;Xhonneux等人,2024年)的对准目标y+y-----------------),通常以“肯定”等合规前缀开头。 然而,为了诚实起见,事实和谎言都取决于背景,所以两个目标都必须逐一构建.

blocks.en: Adversarial training optimizes a min-max objective, where an inner maximization finds a worst-case perturbation and an outer minimization makes the model robust to it ( Madry et al., 2019 ) . In the LLM setting the threat is targeted , such that the attacker aims to elicit one specific, harmful continuation y − y^{-} , of which the inner loop maximizes the likelihood.

blocks.en: We evaluate two models: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Meta AI, 2024 ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . The Qwen model is run with reasoning mode off in both training and evaluation. Qwen’s chat template still emits an empty <think></think> block at the start of the assistant turn. We treat that block as part of the prompt, so the training loss is computed only on the answer that follows it. We use gemma-4-31B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) as the judge for MASK, MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, validated against human annotation. Both training objectives are implemented as custom trainers on top of TRL ( von Werra et al., 2020 ) , and all generation tasks use vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . We train on 8 H200 GPUs and evaluate on 4 H100 GPUs.

blocks.en: We leverage Herbster et al. (2026) ’s training data, which consists of 50 self-reporting scenarios where the model is placed in a fictional prior, e.g., missing a vulnerability in a code review, and is questioned by the user. Each scenario carries two system prompts, one where the model is instructed to lie about the prior action, and the other where the model is instructed to be truthful. The evaluated model generates five completions for each variant, and each is scored by gpt-oss-120b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) that returns a verdict indicating whether the completion followed its assigned condition (honest/dishonest). We keep only completions whose verdict matches their condition, dropping scenarios left with no usable dishonest completion. These are then paired within each scenario to form ( y + y^{+} , y − y^{-} ) contrast pairs, along with the dishonest system prompt ( x x ) as adversarial context. This yields the final 𝒟 adv \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{adv}} consisting of 216 rows of on-policy training data over 45 scenarios for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and 224 rows across 47 scenarios for Qwen3.6-27B.

blocks.en: We evaluate the honesty-intervention methods on three benchmarks where dishonesty manifests differently, as well as capability benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们根据不诚实表现不同的三个基准以及能力基准评估诚实干预方法。

blocks.en: MASK benchmark. MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) asks whether a model contradicts itself under pressure. For each scenario, it first elicits the model’s belief about a proposition in a neutral context, then puts the model under pressure, and compares the model’s answers under the two. Every pressured response with an elicited belief falls into one of three classes: it asserts what the model believes ( honest ), asserts the opposite ( dishonest ), or asserts neither, by hedging or refusing ( ambiguous ). In the literature, the third class is usually folded into the first category, with the honesty score calculated as 100 − dishonest rate 100-\text{dishonest rate} , so a model that simply stops making claims or refuses most times scores well. Thus, we report all three instead of collapsing them into one number. As for accuracy, some propositions yield no consistent belief. Yet if we do not know what the model thinks, we cannot say whether it contradicted itself. We therefore drop those items before computing honesty rates. We use the full n = 1000 n=1000 in MASK and gemma-4-31B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) as a judge.
blocks.zh: MASK基准. MASCK(Ren等,2025年)询问一个模型是否在压力下自相矛盾. 对每一种情况来说,它首先引出模型在中性上下文中对一个命题的信念,然后将模型置于压力之下,并在两者下比较模型的答案. 每一个带有某种信念的压力反应都属于三个类别之一:它声称模型所相信的(诚实),声称相反(不诚实),或者通过套期保值或拒绝(模棱两可)来断言两者均不然。 在文献中,第三类通常被折叠为第一类,诚实分数被计算为100–不诚实分数100-\text{不诚实分数},所以这个模式只是停止提出主张或者拒绝大多数好评. 因此,我们报告这三个国家,而不是将它们合并成一个数字。 至于准确性,一些命题没有产生一致的信念. 然而,如果我们不知道这个模式的想法,我们就不能说它是否自相矛盾。 因此,在计算诚实率之前,我们先放弃这些项目。 在MASK和Gemma-4-31B-it(Gemma Team,2026年)中,我们使用满分n=1000n=1000作为裁判.

blocks.en: Among Us. Among Us ( Golechha and Garriga-Alonso, 2025 ) is a seven-agent social-deduction game sandbox in which the Impostor role can only win by lying consistently across many turns. We fix the matchup in our setting such that both impostors are the model with honesty interventions and all five crewmates are the base model of the same architecture. We run 100 games per method and compare each method against the baseline where the base model plays the Impostor role. We report mainly (i) impostor win rate , over completed games; and (ii) confession rate , the share of games in which an impostor admits its role in a meeting, detected by a fixed regex matcher over parsed messages. 2 2 2 The lexical matcher is applied identically across conditions, and it is a lower bound as it may miss paraphrased admissions.
blocks.zh: 在我们当中(Golechha和Garriga-Alonso,2025年),是一个七大代理社交诱导游戏沙盒,其中冒牌角色只能通过在许多回合中一致地躺着取胜。 我们在设定中解决匹配问题 使得两个冒名顶替者都是诚实干预的模型 所有五个船员都是同一建筑的基础模型 我们每个方法运行100个游戏,并且将每个方法与基准模型发挥Impostor作用的基准进行比较. 我们主要报告(一) 假冒者赢率,超过已完成的游戏;以及(二) 供认率,即假冒者承认其在会中角色的游戏份额,由固定的regex匹配者在解析消息后检测出. 2个 2个 2 词汇匹配器在各种条件之间适用相同,它是一个下限,因为它可能错失了解释性的承认。

blocks.en: AuditBench. AuditBench ( Sheshadri et al., 2026 ) starts from models that have been given a hidden behaviour and trained to conceal it when asked directly, and scores how often an auditing technique uncovers that behaviour. We use the two synthetic-document organisms provided in AuditBench, which are built on Llama-3.3-70B using SFT and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO). We perform five audits (as opposed to 16 in the published AuditBench results due to compute constraints) per 14 hidden behaviours, applying our LoRA adaptor trained with CATCH to the organism to see whether the model reveals its hidden behaviours, and report the discovery rate averaged over them. We leave out the transcript-trained organisms where no method beats the default auditor at all, following Herbster et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 审计本奇。 Audit Bench(Sheshadri等人,2026年)从被赋予隐藏行为并接受过直接询问时隐藏行为训练的模型开始,并评分审计技术如何频繁地发现这种行为. 我们使用Audit Bench中提供的两种合成文件生物,它们使用SFT和Kahneman-Tversky优化(KTO)在Llama-3.3-70B上建造. 我们每14个隐性行为进行5次审计(而不是由于计算限制而公布的 " 审计本奇结果 " 中的16次),将经过 " CATCH " 培训的LORA适配器应用于机体,以了解模型是否揭示其隐性行为,并报告发现率的平均值。 我们不提那些经过笔录训练的生物,

blocks.en: Capability benchmarks. To check that honesty training does not deteriorate general ability, we evaluate on (i) MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , zero-shot over all 57 subjects ( n = 14,042 n=14{,}042 ); (ii) MT-Bench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , a two-turn benchmark with 80 questions, scored with gemma-4-31B-it (1-10); and (iii) AlpacaEval ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) , where gemma-4-31B-it chooses between the trained model’s answer and the corresponding base model’s. Since win rate is sensitive to response length, we report the length-controlled (LC) rate, fitting a logistic regression on the log token counts of both answers and evaluating it at the median length. A win rate below 50% indicates a degradation in instruction-following quality relative to the base model.
blocks.zh: 能力基准。 为了检查诚实训练不会恶化一般能力,我们评价了(一) MMLU(Hendrycks等,2021年),对所有57个科目的零射入(n=14.042 n=14{,}042年);(二) MT-Bench(Bai等,2024年),一个有80个问题的双回转基准,用Gemma-4-31B-it(1-10)打分;和(三) AlpacaEval(Dubois等,2024年),其中Gemma-4-31B-it选择了训练过的模型的答案和相应的基模的答案. 由于中和率对响应长度很敏感,所以我们报告长度控制(LC)率,在两个答案的日志符号计数上配上后勤回归并按中和长度评价. 低于50%的中和率表明,与基准模型相比,教学质量下降。

blocks.en: Figure 5: CATCH preserves utility. Length-controlled AlpacaEval win rate of each honesty intervention against the base model. The dashed line at 50% is parity with the base model. CATCH stays at parity on both models. Error bars are 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over prompts.
blocks.zh: 图5:CATCH保持了效用. 长控阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔胜出 每一次诚实干预 与基础模型。 50%的虚线与基准模型是等同的。 CATCH在两种模式上保持平分. 错误栏是95%的靴子置信间隔。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
We present the results of honesty-intervention methods on the three manifestations of dishonesty: instructed (MASK), incentive-driven (Among Us) and trained-in (AuditBench), followed by capability preservation and the effect of
the utility corpus. To keep the figures legible, the main text shows the honest-persona prompting variants, Steering (StTP), SFT-t, SFT-tau, and
reports CAPO with the DPO loss; the full results of all baselines and both CAPO losses are in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了诚实干预方法对三种不诚实表现的结果:指示(MASK)、鼓励(Ammong Us)和训练(Audit Bench),然后是能力保存和效果
公用设施。 为了保持数字清晰可见,正文显示了诚实-人称提示变体,"引导"(StTP),"SFT-t","SFT-tau"和"SFT-tau".
将所有基线和CAPO损失的全部结果列入附录。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows that CATCH raises the honest rate from 34% to 86% on Llama-3.3-70B and from 47% to 91% on Qwen3.6-27B. The strongest baselines are the honest-persona prompt and SFT-tau. SFT-t falls below every prompting variant. CAPO-DPO matches CATCH on Llama but is lower on Qwen, and lowers MASK accuracy to 70% and 54%, against 79% and 67% for the base models, because it leaves
more scenarios without an elicitable belief (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh:
图2显示,Llama-3.3-70B的诚实率从34%提高到86%,Qune3.6-27B的诚实率从47%提高到91%。 最强的基线是诚实-人气-即时和SFT-tau. SFT-t跌倒在每一个提示变体下. CAPO-DPO在Llama上与CATCH相匹配,但在Quen上则较低,将MASK的精度降低到70%和54%,而基型则降低到79%和67%,因为它离开
(a) 更多没有可引证的信念的情景(附录A.4)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports two measures over 100 games per method, with the intervened model playing the Impostor. Prompting and SFT-t barely change either. CATCH lowers the Impostor win rate from 39% to 20% on Llama-3.3-70B and from 48% to 12% on Qwen3.6-27B, and raises the confession rate from 5% to 84% and from 19% to 85%. SFT-tau increases confession rates to 14% and 58%, better than SFT-t but still below the full CATCH. Additional measures, including checks that the Impostors are still playing the game, are in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 图3显示,每种方法有两道措施超过100个游戏,而干预模式则使用 " Impostor " 。 提示和SFT -T也几乎没有改变。 在Llama-3.3-70B和Qune3.6-27B上,CATCH将印花胜率从39%降至20%,从48%降至12%,并将招供率从5%提高到84%,从19%提高到85%。 SFT-tau将招供率提高到14%和58%,比SFT-t好,但仍低于完整的CATCH. 其他措施,包括检查冒牌货仍在玩游戏,见附录A.5。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the results of CAT applied to the Llama-3.3-70B model trained with hidden quirks in AuditBench. On the SFT-adversarial organism, the default auditor uncovers the hidden behaviour in 43% of audits; after CAT, the same auditor reaches 79% (55/70). On the KTO-adversarial organism, where no tool scores higher than 50%, CAT reaches 93% (65/70). CAT is above every tool (except scaffolding) reported in the AuditBench paper on both settings. 3 3 3 We could also add scaffolding to our method to boost the performance. CAT is on par with Herbster et al. (2026) ’s SOTA steering baseline, where StTP reaches 83% on the SFT organism, above CAT, and 91% on the KTO organism, just below it.
blocks.zh: 图4显示《禁止酷刑公约》应用于Llama-3.3-70B模式的结果,该模式在审计本克接受了隐形怪胎的培训。 在SFT-对抗机体方面,默认审计员在43%的审计中发现了隐蔽的行为;在CAT之后,同一审计员达到79%(55/70)。 在KTO-对抗机体上,没有任何工具得分高于50%,CAT达到93%(65/70). CAT凌驾于关于两种设置的审计奔驰文件所报道的每一个工具(脚手架除外)之上. 3 3 3 我们还可以增加脚手架来提升性能 CAT与Herbster等人(2026年)的SOTA引导基线相当,在STP上方的STFT生物上达到83%,在KTO生物上达到91%,就在它的下方。

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows whether each intervention leaves general instruction following intact. On AlpacaEval, CATCH is at parity with the base model on both architectures, at 51.3% and 51.8%. Under the honest-persona prompts, both models open their replies with commentary on the “honest-only” mode before answering, and win rates collapse to 9-12%. Steering barely affects Qwen (45.2%) but drops Llama to 8.6%. CATCH also stays within one point of base on MMLU and at or slightly above it on MT-Bench (Appendix A.6 ).
blocks.zh: 图5显示每项干预措施是否都保留了完整的一般指导。 在阿尔帕卡埃瓦尔,CATCH与两个建筑的基础模型处于等同状态,分别为51.3%和51.8%. 在诚实的Persona提示下,两个模型在回答前都会用“诚实的-唯一”模式发表评论来解答,赢率会跌至9-12%。 转向力几乎没有影响Quen(45.2%),但将Llama降到了8.6%. CATCH还停留在MMLU上的一个基点内,并停留在MT-Bench上或稍稍上方(附录A.6).

blocks.en: Figure 6: On-policy utility data retains capability better than UltraChat. Each plot shows two Pareto fronts of MASK honesty against AlpacaEval LC win rate, one with CATCH trained with an on-policy utility dataset, and the other trained with UltraChat, an off-policy utility dataset; everything else fixed. The MASK honesty score represents the proportion of honest answers out of all scenarios with elicited belief.
blocks.zh: 图6:政策公用事业数据保留能力优于UltraChat。 每个情节显示了两个Pareto战线的MASK诚实对抗AlpacaEval LC取胜率,一个战线由CATCH训练,一个战线由政策公用事业数据集,另一个战线由UltraChat训练,一个非政策公用事业数据集;其他一切固定. MASCK诚实得分代表着所有情景中信得过信的诚实回答比例.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows MASK honesty against the AlpacaEval LC win rate over the course of training, with one Pareto curve per utility corpus. The runs are otherwise identical, using the same adversarial data, the same objective, and the same hyperparameters. For both models, both the on-policy (Magpie) and off-policy (UltraChat) utility data reach a similar level of honesty (73.9 vs 73.6), but they differ substantially in capability measured by AlpacaEval. Specifically, reaching comparable honesty scores on Llama-3.3-70B, the on-policy data maintains the AlpacaEval win rate at 51.3, while UltraChat drops it to 22.0. Similarly, on Qwen3.6-27B, though the UltraChat run scored slightly higher in honesty score (80.6) than Magpie-Qwen3.6 (74.1), its win rate decreases to 28.7, while Magpie-Qwen3.6 maintains it at 51.8.
blocks.zh: 图6显示MASK诚实与阿尔帕卡-Eval LC在培训过程中的取胜率,每个公用设施有一个Pareto曲线。 运行在其他方面是相同的,使用相同的对抗数据,同一个目标,同一个超参数. 对于这两个模型,政策(Magpie)和不政策(UltraChat)的效用数据都达到了类似的诚实程度(73.9对73.6),但它们在由AlpacaEval测量的能力上大相径庭。 具体而言,在Llama-3.3-70B上达到可比较的诚实分数,政策上的数据保持了阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔的胜率51.3,而UltraChat则降到了22.0. 同样地,在Qwen3.6-27B上,虽然UltraChat跑在诚实分数(80.6分)上得分略高于Magpie-Qune3.6(74.1),其取胜率也降至28.7分,而Magpie-Qune3.6则保持了51.8分.

blocks.en: Off-policy data may do better when it comes from a more capable model. Training Llama-3.3-70B with Magpie-Qwen3.6, which is generated by a newer and stronger model, raises its win rate to 85.3, consistent with the utility term acting as distillation from a stronger teacher (Appendix A.7 ). A stronger teacher, however, is not always available, whereas on-policy data can be generated for any model one can train.
blocks.zh: 政策外数据如果来自更有能力的模型,可能做得更好。 由较新更强的模型所生成的Magpie-Qune3.6对Llama-3.3-70B进行训练,将其取胜率提高到85.3,这与作为更强教师分馏的实用术语一致(附录A.7). 然而,并非总能有一个更强大的教师,而对于任何模式,都可以生成政策数据。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: CATCH improves honesty on all three evaluations implemented, where dishonesty manifests due to different causes, outperforming all the baselines. On MASK, SFT on the honest targets reaches only 55% and 60% honesty on Llama and Qwen; adding the dishonest targets (SFT-TA) raises this to 77% and 88%. Prompting with honest persona makes both models achieve similar level of honesty to SFT-TA. However, CATCH is still the most honest on MASK, and this honesty transfers to other benchmarks, while all prompting and SFT baselines do not generalize well to Among Us.
blocks.zh: CATCH改进了所有三项评价的诚实,这些评价由于不同的原因表现出不诚实,超过了所有基线。 在MASK上,诚实目标的SFT在Llama和Quen上只达到55%和60%的诚实;加上不诚实的目标(SFT-TA),这个比例提高到了77%和88%. 与诚实人物的激励a 使两种模式都实现了与SFT-TA相似的诚实水平. 然而,CATCH在MASK上仍然是最诚实的,这种诚实性转移到了其他基准,而所有的提示和SFT基线对我们来说并不是很普遍。

blocks.en: The closest competitor to CATCH is StTP ( Herbster et al., 2026 ) , the strongest activation-steering method to date for honesty. CATCH outperforms it on MASK, and the two are comparable on Among Us and AuditBench. They also differ in terms of capability degradation. At the steering strength behind its results, StTP lowers the AlpacaEval LC win rate to 8.6% on Llama and 45.2% on Qwen, whereas CATCH stays at parity on both (51.3% and 51.8%). Using a weaker steering strength would lead to less utility degradation, but also to less honesty ( Herbster et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 与CATCH最相近的竞争者是StTP(Herbster等,2026年),这是迄今为止最强的活化-探险方法来达到诚实. CATCH在MASC上表现优于它,两者在"我们中"和"审计奔驰"上是相仿的. 它们在能力退化方面也有所不同。 在结果背后的引导力下,STRP将Llama和Quen的AlpacaEval LC取胜率分别降至8.6%和45.2%,而CATCH则保持在51.3%和51.8%的平分水平上。 使用较弱的转向力将减少功用退化,但也减少诚实(Herbster等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Our findings differ from that of Wang et al. (2025) , who find prompting and fine-tuning to be the most effective mitigations. In our setting, using 200 adversarial targets to train two open-weight models with CATCH gives better MASK performance than in Wang et al. (2025) ’s setting, where roughly fifty times as much training data was used to SFT a bigger and more capable model ( Claude Sonnet 3.7 ). We cannot test CATCH on closed-source model for a more direct comparison. We limit our claim to the small-data regime: with a few hundred targets, CATCH is more effective than SFT.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果与王等(2025)不同,王等认为激励和微调是最有效的缓解措施. 在我们的设定中,使用200个对抗目标来训练两个带有CATCH的开放量级模型,比出自Wang等人(2025年)的设定中,MASK的性能要好,当时使用的培训数据大约是SFT一个更大更能胜任的模型(Claude Sonnet 3.7)的50倍。 我们不能用闭源模型测试CATCH,以进行更直接的比较. 我们的主张仅限于小数据制度:有几百个目标,CATCH比SFT更有效.

blocks.en: Preserving capability during robustness training depends heavily on the choice of utility dataset. Prior work in adversarial training commonly used UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ) for this purpose ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Xhonneux et al., 2024 ; Sheshadri et al., 2025 ; Dékány et al., 2025 ) . With it, Xhonneux et al. (2024) report MT-Bench degradation for every model they train, attributing it to the trade-off between robustness and utility. However, our ablation indicates that much of the cost comes from the choice of utility dataset. Using on-policy utility data in CATCH retains capability for both our trained models to the same level as the base model in AlpacaEval, MMLU and MT-Bench.
blocks.zh: 稳健性培训期间的保存能力在很大程度上取决于公用事业数据集的选择。 常用的对抗性训练的前期工作 为此,Chat(Ding等,2023年) (Bai等,2024年;Xhonneux等,2024年;Sheshadri等,2025年;Dékány等,2025年). 与之相接的有克霍内克等. (2024年)报告了MT-Bench退化的情况,说明它们培训的每一种模型都属于强性和效用之间的取舍。 然而,我们的削减表明,大部分费用来自公用事业数据集的选择。 使用CATCH中的政策性通用数据,我们两个训练有素的模型的能力都保持在与阿尔帕卡埃瓦尔、MMLU和MT-Bench的基准模型相同的水平。

blocks.en: We also tried CAPO, another adversarial training method, which successfully improves honesty on MASK and Among Us, but is accompanied with degraded capabilities. It also produces behavioural changes: in Among Us, CAPO-trained Impostors decline to play in 35% of games, giving reasons about harm ( “I can’t help with that because it involves harming others.” ). One possible explanation is that preference optimization can shift probability onto responses the preference pairs (toward and away targets) never specified ( Razin et al., 2025 ) . Another reading is that honesty and harmlessness have overlapping representations: Siu et al. (2026) shows that interventions targeting one safety behaviour can affect others.
blocks.zh: 我们还尝试了CAPO,这是另一种对抗性训练方法,它成功地提高了MASK和我们中间的诚实,但伴随着能力下降. 也会产生行为变化:在"我们中"中,CAPO训练有素的冒牌货拒绝在35%的游戏中出演,给出了伤害的原因("我对此无能为力,因为它涉及伤害他人"). 一种可能的解释是,优待优化可以将概率转移到从未规定的优待对(向上和向下的目标)的反应(Razin等人,2025年)。 另一种观点是,诚实和无害性有重叠的表述: 萧等. (2026年)表明,针对一种安全行为的干预措施会影响到其他安全行为.

blocks.en: Some limitations exist in our work. CATCH requires white-box access, so it cannot be applied to closed-source APIs. We train LoRA adapters on all linear layers, but prior work on honesty steering finds that the middle layers carry most of the relevant signal ( Herbster et al., 2026 ) , so restricting the update would make full fine-tuning affordable and potentially leading to even higher honesty; however, we have not tested this. A possible next step could be to probe model activations to study how CATCH changes the internal representation of deception. Finally, future work could also evaluate CATCH’s robustness to emergent misalignment ( Betley et al., 2026 ) , for example, by evaluating whether CATCH trained on the base model can still improve honesty on a broadly misaligned model.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作有一些局限性。 CATCH需要白箱访问,因此不能被应用到闭源API上. 我们在所有线性地层上训练LORA适配器,但之前的诚实引导工作发现,中间地层携带了大多数相关的信号(Herbster等,2026年),因此限制更新可以使完全的微调可以负担得起,并有可能导致更高的诚实;然而,我们还没有测试过这一点. 下一步可以探索模型活化,研究CATCH如何改变欺骗的内部表现. 最后,未来的工作还可以评价CATCH的强性来应对突发的错配(Betley等,2026年),例如通过评价CATCH在基础模型上接受的训练是否能够在广义的错配模型上改善诚实.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced CATCH, and showed it is a practical and data-efficient way to make an LLM more honest. Trained on a few hundred targets and evaluated on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3.6-27B, CATCH enables models to learn an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers to different dishonesty manifestations. CATCH substantially reduces instructed dishonesty on MASK, raises the confession rate under game incentives in Among Us, and makes a trained-in hidden behaviour easier to surface on AuditBench. General capability is preserved under CATCH, and this depends on the utility corpus: while off-policy corpora can degrade model’s utility substantially, on-policy data consistently retain it.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了CATCH, 并显示这是一个实用和数据效率高的方法, 使LLM更加诚实。 CATCH对几百个目标进行了培训,并对Llama-3.3-70B-Instructionct和Qune3.6-27B进行了评价,它使模型能够学习一种诚实的行为,有力地概括并转移到不同的不诚实的表现。 CATCH大幅降低了对MASCK的不诚实指示,提高了游戏激励下的忏悔率(United Us),并使得经过训练的隐蔽行为更容易在"审计奔驰"上露面. 一般能力在CATCH下保留,这取决于通用程序:虽然非政策公司可以大幅度地降低模型的实用性,但政策数据始终保留它。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: Generative AI systems are used in this work. We fine-tuned and evaluated LLMs, used them to generate our training data, ran them as agents in the Among Us environment and as investigator agents in AuditBench, and used them as automated judges under fixed prompts and rubrics for MASK, AlpacaEval, and MT-Bench. Generative AI tools also helped with carrying out the research, including code development and debugging, plotting, and checking results. We also used them to revise and improve the readability of parts of the manuscript.
blocks.zh: 本作采用了基因AI系统. 我们微调和评价了LLMS, 利用它们来生成我们的培训数据, 把他们作为我们环境中的特工 和审计本奇的调查员, Generative AI工具还帮助开展研究,包括代码的开发以及调试,图谋和检查结果等. 我们还利用它们修改并改进了部分手稿的可读性.

blocks.en:
Prompting and SFT-t leave the win rate and confession rate at or near the
base level on both models. SFT-tau, which trains on the same targets as CATCH without the adversarial perturbation, raises the confession rate from 5% to only 14% on Llama and to 58% on Qwen, against 84% and 85% for CATCH. The perturbation therefore contributes far more under transfer than on MASK, where it adds 8.7 and 3.1 points of honesty (Appendix A.4 ). StTP and CAPO-DPO also reach high confession rates on both models. CAPO with the IPO loss does so on Llama (92%) but not on Qwen (12%).
blocks.zh:
SFT-T 的诱导率和招供率在或接近
两个模型上的基础水平。 SFT-tau(SFT-tau)在与CATCH相同的目标上进行训练,没有对抗性的干扰,将Llama的供认率从5%提高到了14%,Quen的供认率提高到了58%,而CATCH的供认率则从84%和85%提高到了58%. 因此,与MASK相比,扰动在转移中的贡献要多得多,它增加了8.7和3.1的诚实点(附录A.4)。 StTP和CAPO-DPO在两种模式上也都达到了高招供率. IPO损失的CAPO在Llama(92%)上这样做,但在Quen(12%)上却没有这样做.

blocks.en:
The remaining measures show whether these gains come with the model still
playing the game. CATCH emits a valid action on nearly every turn, speaks on
every discussion turn on Llama, and never refuses to play. On Qwen its SPEAK
rate falls to 70% because the model tends to confess in the first turn of a
meeting and then stops contributing, having acknowledged that it cannot win.
CAPO on Llama is the clearest case of an intervention that lowers the win rate by withdrawing: it emits a valid action on 71% of turns, speaks on 44% of discussion turns, and refuses to play in 35% of games; CAPO-DPO refuses in 24%. Among the prompting baselines, the prefill lowers valid actions on both models (89% and 81%), and the honest persona breaks Qwen’s output format almost entirely, with valid actions on 1% of turns and messages on 2% of discussion turns, so its other values on Qwen are not interpretable.

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows every checkpoint for each utility corpus. We compare corpora at the most honest point on each front, which lies between 71.7 and 80.6 MASK honesty for every run (Table 5 ). Magpie-Qwen3.6 is the same corpus for both models, which makes it on-policy for Qwen3.6-27B and external for Llama-3.3-70B. The table also lists two runs left out of the figure: Magpie-Qwen2.5, and a second, coding-heavy version of Magpie-Qwen3.6.
blocks.zh: 图10显示每个公用设施每个检查站。 我们比较每个战线上最诚实的Corpora,每跑一次在71.7到80.6MASK诚实之间(表5). Magpie-Quen3.6是两种模型的同一种活体,这使得它成为了Quen3.6-27B的上政策,而Llama-3.3-70B的外政策. 该表还列出了图中被忽略的两个跑道:Magpie-Quen2.5,和第二个,编码重的"Magpie-Quen3.6.

blocks.en: On Llama-3.3-70B, the corpora are ordered by the release date of the model that generated them. UltraChat-200k, generated with ChatGPT in 2023, drops to 21.2. Magpie-Qwen2.5 (September 2024) reaches 43.2, and the on-policy Magpie-Llama-3.3 (December 2024) stays at parity with 51.3. Magpie-Qwen3.6, generated by a model released in April 2026, goes well past parity to 85.3.
blocks.zh: 在Llama-3.3-70B上,蝎子由生成它们的模型的发布日期来订购. UltraChat-200k,由ChatGPT于2023年生成,下降至21.2. Magpie-Quen2.5 (2024年9月) 达到 43.2, 政策上的 Magpie-Llama-3.3 (2024年12月) 保持51.3的平分. 由2026年4月发布的模型所生成的Magpie-Qune3.6远超85.3.

blocks.en: The middle panel puts these Llama-3.3-70B checkpoints on the same reference as Qwen3.6-27B. The untrained Llama-3.3-70B wins only 11.4% of comparisons against the untrained Qwen3.6-27B, so Qwen3.6-27B is the stronger model under this judge. Training with Magpie-Qwen3.6 raises this to 21.5, while the other corpora stay between 8.3 and 10.4. This closes part of the gap between the two models, but not all of it. Some of the gain may also come from Llama-3.3-70B picking up the style of Qwen3.6-27B, whose answers are the reference in this panel.
blocks.zh: 中间小组将这些Llama-3.3-70B检查站与Qune3.6-27B一样。 未受训练的Llama-3.3-70B与未受训练的Qwen3.6-27B相比,只获得11.4%的比分,因此Qune3.6-27B是本裁判下更强大的模式. 与Magpie-Qune3.6的训练将这提高到了21.5分,而另一只蝎子则停留在8.3至10.4分之间. 这拉近了两个模型之间的部分差距,但不是全部. 部分增益也可能出自Llama-3.3-70B取出Quen3.6-27B的风格,其答案就是这个面板中的参考.

blocks.en: On Qwen3.6-27B, the release-date order does not hold. The two Magpie corpora generated by 2024 models fall far below parity, to 3.6 (Magpie-Llama-3.3) and 12.8 (Magpie-Qwen2.5). Both are also below UltraChat-200k (28.7), the oldest corpus. Only the on-policy Magpie-Qwen3.6 stays at parity with 51.8. How the on-policy corpus is sampled also matters: the coding-heavy version, generated with a single system prompt that led to about 88% coding prompts, reaches 42.2.
blocks.zh: 在Qwen3.6-27B上,发布日期令没有执行. 由2024年模型所生成的两种Magpie corpora远低于等分,分别为3.6(Magpie-Llama-3.3)和12.8(Magpie-Quen2.5). 两者也都低于最古老的"UltraChat-200k"(28.7). 只有政策上的Magpie-Quen3.6保持51.8的平价。 如何对政策指令进行抽样也很重要:编码重度版本由单一的系统提示生成,导致大约88%的编码提示,达到42.2.

blocks.en: Overall, on-policy data keeps both models at parity (51.3 and 51.8), while external corpora range from 3.6 to 85.3 depending on the model being trained. Data from a stronger model can do better, as Magpie-Qwen3.6 does for Llama-3.3-70B. But such data does not exist for every model, whereas on-policy data can be generated for any model we train.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,政策数据使两个模型保持均等(51.3和51.8),而外部公司的范围则从3.6到85.3不等,这取决于正在培训的模式。 来自更强模型的数据可以做得更好,如Magpie-Quen3.6对Llama-3.3-70B所做的. 但并不是每个模型都有这种数据,而对于我们训练的任何模型,都可以生成政策数据。
